options.name: api_timeout
options.description: How long should the socket layer wait before timing out for API calls. If this is omitted, nothing will be passed to the requests library.

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary containing auth information as needed by the cloud's auth plugin strategy. For the default I(password) plugin, this would contain I(auth_url), I(username), I(password), I(project_name) and any information about domains (for example, I(os_user_domain_name) or I(os_project_domain_name)) if the cloud supports them. For other plugins, this param will need to contain whatever parameters that auth plugin requires. This parameter is not needed if a named cloud is provided or OpenStack OS_* e

options.name: auth_type
options.description: Name of the auth plugin to use. If the cloud uses something other than password authentication, the name of the plugin should be indicated here and the contents of the I(auth) parameter should be updated accordingly.

options.name: ca_cert
options.description: A path to a CA Cert bundle that can be used as part of verifying SSL API requests.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: A path to a client certificate to use as part of the SSL transaction.

options.name: client_key
options.description: A path to a client key to use as part of the SSL transaction.

options.name: cloud
options.description: Named cloud or cloud config to operate against. If I(cloud) is a string, it references a named cloud config as defined in an OpenStack clouds.yaml file. Provides default values for I(auth) and I(auth_type). This parameter is not needed if I(auth) is provided or if OpenStack OS_* environment variables are present. If I(cloud) is a dict, it contains a complete cloud configuration like would be in a section of clouds.yaml.

options.name: container_format
options.description: Specifies the container type.

options.name: disk_format
options.description: Specifies the image format.

options.name: enterprise_project_id
options.description: Specifies the enterprise project to which the images to be queried belong.

options.name: id
options.description: ID of the image to be queried.

options.name: imagetype
options.description: Specifies the image type.

options.name: interface
options.description: Endpoint URL type to fetch from the service catalog.

options.name: isregistered
options.description: Specifies whether the image is available.

options.name: marker
options.description: Specifies the start number from which images are queried. The value is the image ID.

options.name: member_status
options.description: Specifies the member status. Visibility must be set to "shared" during the query.

options.name: min_disk
options.description: Specifies the minimum disk space (GB) required for running the image.

options.name: min_ram
options.description: Specifies the minimum memory size (MB) required for running the image.

options.name: name
options.description: name of the image to be queried.

options.name: os_bit
options.description: Specifies the OS architecture, 32 bit or 64 bit.

options.name: os_type
options.description: Specifies the image OS type.

options.name: owner
options.description: Specifies the tenant to which the image belongs.

options.name: platform
options.description: Specifies the image platform type.

options.name: protected
options.description: Specifies whether the image is protected.

options.name: region_name
options.description: Name of the region.

options.name: sdk_log_level
options.description: Log level of the OpenStackSDK

options.name: sdk_log_path
options.description: Path to the logfile of the OpenStackSDK. If empty no log is written

options.name: status
options.description: Specifies the image status.

options.name: support_diskintensive
options.description: Specifies whether the image supports disk-intensive ECSs.

options.name: support_highperformance
options.description: Specifies whether the image supports high-performance ECSs.

options.name: support_kvm
options.description: Specifies whether the image supports KVM.

options.name: support_kvm_gpu_type
options.description: Specifies whether the image supports GPU-accelerated ECSs on the KVM platform. This attribute cannot co-exist with support_xen and support_kvm.

options.name: support_kvm_infiniband
options.description: Specifies whether the image supports ECSs with InfiniBand NICs on the KVM platform. This attribute cannot co-exist with support_xen.

options.name: support_largememory
options.description: Specifies whether the image supports large-memory ECSs.

options.name: support_xen
options.description: Specifies whether the image supports Xen.

options.name: support_xen_gpu_type
options.description: Specifies whether the image supports GPU-accelerated ECSs on the KVM platform. This attribute cannot co-exist with support_xen and support_kvm.

options.name: support_xen_hana
options.description: Specifies whether the image supports HANA ECSs on the Xen platform. This attribute cannot co-exist with support_xen and support_kvm.

options.name: system_cmkid
options.description: Specifies the ID of the key used to encrypt the image.

options.name: tag
options.description: Specifies a tag added to an image.

options.name: timeout
options.description: How long should ansible wait for the requested resource.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not SSL API requests should be verified. Before Ansible 2.3 this defaulted to C(yes).

options.name: virtual_env_type
options.description: Specifies the environment where the image is used.

options.name: visibility
options.description: Specifies whether the image is available to other tenants.

options.name: wait
options.description: Should ansible wait until the requested resource is complete.

options.name: whole_image
options.description: Specifies whether the image is a full-ECS image.
